title: Constraint: Two Matrices, Unique Minimums
constraints: `a` and `b` are 3 × 3 matrices of 5-bit values. In each matrix the minimum value occurs **exactly once**, and the minimum of `a` is smaller than the minimum of `b`.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Helper variables `ma`, `mb` for the minima: every element ≥ helper, at least one equals it.
"Exactly once": no two cells both equal the minimum (pairwise).

examples.check: each matrix has a unique minimum
